newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint Q4 gross margin rises.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint Q4 gross margin rises.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Tuesday its gross margin for the fourth quarter of 1996 rose to 8.12 percent from 7.07 percent in 1995, while its gross margin for the year increased to 7.77 percent from 6.73 percent.

Brightpoint said the margin improvement was due primarily to an increase in the amount of higher-margin, value-added logistic services, as well as increased sales in certain markets that generate higher margins.
Reduced lower-margin sales to other distributors in North America slowed unit sales growth but improved gross margins.
Brightpoint earned $0.25 a share in the fourth quarter, up from $0.15 a year ago, and $0.73 for the year versus $0.53.

"Our performance in the fourth quarter reflects the growing importance of world markets that are new to Brightpoint," Robert Laikin, chairman, said in a statement. "Sales growth in these international markets, together with enhancements in our company's value-added service capabilities, support our confidence that we are well positioned to execute our business strategy in 1997."
Brightpoint distributes wireless communication equipment and related services.
